Basic chat completion against real Google Gemini API

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["maxTokens" => 10, "messages" => [["content" => "Say hello in exactly one word.", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite"]));
$apiKey = getenv('GEMINI_API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('GEMINI_API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->chat($req);
var_dump($result->getChoices());
var_dump($result->getUsage());
```
